I've written the playbook for 01-data-foundation: `.wire/releases/01-data-foundation/planning/01-data-foundation_playbook.md` (454 lines, 17 steps). It is template level, because no artifact in this release has been generated yet. A note at the top says to re-run it after requirements.

**What it contains**

| Section | Content |
|---|---|
| Control-flow diagram | A step-by-step diagram (BPMN style, drawn in Mermaid) covering six phases in order: Requirements, Design, Development, Testing, Deployment, Enablement. Each review that asks for changes loops back to its generate step. |
| Steps | Requirements, workshops, conceptual model, pipeline design, logical model (optional), data model, mockups, pipeline, orchestration, dbt, semantic layer, dashboards, data quality, user acceptance testing (UAT), deployment, training, documentation. |
| Closing sections | Daily rhythm, what Wire does and does not do, and a table of every Wire command used. |

**Left out:** business rules (marked not applicable in `status.md`), seed data, viz catalog and data refactor (these apply only to dashboard-first releases), and dbtcharts and agents schema (the statement of work does not ask for them).

**Open questions taken from the statement of work and engagement notes**

- 2 questions block progress, so the diagram stops at each until it is answered:
  - **OQ-7:** launch all markets in version 1, or in phases (owner: Becky). Blocks the start of Development.
  - **OQ-3:** one agreed list of cancel reasons (Shopify has 8, Stripe 4, the customer service team 14; owners: Steph and Cathy). Blocks the churn model in dbt.
- 10 more open questions (OQ-1, 2, 4, 5, 6, 8 to 12) and 4 data quality issues (DQ-1 to DQ-4) are placed at the steps they affect.

**Dates need checking.** The playbook uses the statement of work's 12-week window, 27 January to 17 April 2026. That does not match the engagement record, which shows a creation date of 31 May 2026. The playbook marks these dates as provisional.

**Other changes:**
- I logged the run in `execution_log.md`. The file did not exist, so I created it.
- The playbook was not sent to Confluence, because no page is set up for this release.
- I changed one line: the template-level note at the top used an em-dash, which your organisation's style rules forbid, so I replaced it with a full stop.
- `status.md` was not changed.
- I have not checked that the diagram renders in a Mermaid viewer.
